description: This file provides helper functions for handling real-time updates and parsing meeting details in relation to a 'tasks' table within a project that likely deals with task management. It includes functions for subscribing to real-time changes via Supabase, parsing meeting details from task records, and managing channel subscriptions.

methods.name: subscribeToTasksChanges({  userId,  onChange,  onStatus,  events = ["UPDATE"], })
methods.description: Sets up a real-time subscription to changes on the 'tasks' table, filtering by user ID if provided, and handling specified events (default: UPDATE). Returns an object with an unsubscribe method to remove the subscription.

methods.name: parseMeetingDetailsFromTask(taskRow)
methods.description: Extracts meeting schedule details from a task record, attempting to parse various potential storage locations for meeting information and returning an object with datetime and agenda, or null if no details are found.
